test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘GAS’ is written as ‘54’, and ‘JOG’ is written as ‘49’. How will ‘ZIP’ be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] The logic followed here is: **The sum of the opposite positional value of the given word**​ ‘GAS’ is written as ‘54’ ​
